confirmedRetirementHandoff.compiler: Kotlin 2.4.20 / JDK 21; 192 MiB heap / 128 MiB metaspace
confirmedRetirementHandoff.scope: Actual complete benchmark ownership and NonCancellable bounded handoff helper with real coroutine scheduler and six regressions. No Android, ViewModel, Compose, native speech, device or acoustic qualification. Two actual ViewModel regressions are separately authored for required CI and are not executed here.
verifiedBehavior: Both ASR and synthesis release requests register before any wait, and both confirmations are required before a campaign starts.
Repeated or late callbacks cannot resume the campaign twice.
User cancellation before or during handoff keeps the lease until confirmed cleanup and prevents the campaign.
Lifecycle cancellation cannot release ownership while callbacks are outstanding.
The 30-second timeout quarantines the lease and retains captured owners; late callbacks cannot release the quarantine.
Registration failure requests every owner, including when a callback fires before the registration throws, and fails closed.
Synchronous confirmed callbacks start exactly one campaign.
confirmedRetirementHandoff.integration: ViewModel/settings now accept suspend beforeStart. The ViewModel acquires ownership and sets running before the bounded NonCancellable barrier, retains the owner callback closure on unconfirmed cleanup, and checks cancellation before runFull. The screen awaits actual ASR/Kokoro callbacks separately; current callback implementations and the full app require their own verification.
confirmedRetirementHandoff.viewModelRegressions: Two actual ViewModel regressions for stopped/lifecycle-cancelled handoff are authored for CI; they are not claimed executed by this helper receipt.
